{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "audited_spec": "references/control-loop-harness.md",
  "scope_note": "No spec path was provided; I audited the primary file titled LTO control-loop harness spec.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "LTO-SPEC-PA-001",
      "severity": "blocker",
      "title": "The spec still treats later control modes as future or non-goals after they were implemented.",
      "premature_assumption": "Reviewers can evaluate the system as Phase 1 passive logging while deferring autonomous/judge/mining risks.",
      "evidence": [
        "references/control-loop-harness.md:3 says later phases are still spec.",
        "references/control-loop-harness.md:638 lists no long autonomous loop as a non-goal.",
        "scripts/lto/commands/autopilot.py:104-133 implements autonomous gate plus mechanical execution.",
        "references/backlog.md:15 marks autopilot --autonomous as implemented."
      ],
      "impact": "The spec is no longer reliable as the current review surface; it can approve passive logging while missing already-shipped autonomy behavior.",
      "recommendation": "Split current implementation spec from roadmap, then update non-goals/review questions to cover autonomous, decide, judge, and cross-run mining.",
      "confidence": "high"
    },
    {
      "id": "LTO-SPEC-PA-002",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Privacy/export gating assumes scan and redaction-failure signals that are not concretely defined.",
      "premature_assumption": "Event redaction plus a standalone repo privacy script is enough to make state.json/artifacts.json references export-safe.",
      "evidence": [
        "references/control-loop-harness.md:276-277 defines privacy_findings/redaction_summary as hard export gates.",
        "references/control-loop-harness.md:316 and :581 require state.json/artifacts.json privacy scan marking.",
        "scripts/lto/events.py:255-258 only writes redaction_status as not_required or passed for new events.",
        "scripts/lto/artifacts.py:121-144 emits artifact.registered without an artifact privacy-scan status."
      ],
      "impact": "Telemetry can report no failed redactions while linked state/artifact surfaces were never field-level scanned or marked; the hard gate has no stable predicate.",
      "recommendation": "Add machine-readable privacy_scan status for state/artifacts and make export/closeout/push gates consume it; keep it distinct from event-line redaction status.",
      "confidence": "high"
    },
    {
      "id": "LTO-SPEC-PA-003",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "The metric catalog assumes evidence_count comes from artifacts, but implementation derives it from state.",
      "premature_assumption": "Artifacts are already the evidence source of truth for Phase 1 metrics.",
      "evidence": [
        "references/control-loop-harness.md:273 declares evidence_count source as artifacts.",
        "scripts/lto/telemetry.py:175 computes evidence_count from task.evidence in state.",
        "scripts/lto/commands/runner.py:57 appends evidence directly into task state."
      ],
      "impact": "Consumers may treat evidence_count as artifact-backed proof when it is actually state-backed; this weakens provenance and privacy reasoning.",
      "recommendation": "Either change the catalog source to state or derive evidence_count from artifacts.json entries and test that contract.",
      "confidence": "high"
    }
  ]
}
